ghibli-backgrounds

🌱 seedling
planted apr 2026 · last tended may 11 · #anime#art

A study folder and some observations. Ghibli backgrounds sell scale with detail density, not detail everywhere: the eye-path gets crisp edges, the rest dissolves into shape and temperature.

Trying to steal this at 64×64 for pixel-art-workflow: pick the three pixels that matter, let the rest be gradient. Harder than it sounds. Everything is harder than it sounds at 64×64.
